title: Blueforce enrollment V1 request
description: Sent by bf-enroll from a PROVISIONED_OFFLINE device. Carries public facts only: the WireGuard private key, the one-time token value and every other credential stay on the device. The single-use token travels in the Authorization header, never in this document.

device_id.description: Fleet identity derived from the validated dealer number.

wireguard_public_key.description: Device public key only. The matching private key never leaves the device.

idempotency_key.description: sha256(provisioning_id | device_id | wireguard_public_key). Stable across retries so central can deduplicate retries while the one-time credential stays single-use.
